method: Original baseline metrics retained. Official BC Parks/Parks Canada metric updates are documented by destination. Rebuilt Berg Lake Trail distances are qualified third-party post-reconstruction estimates with original official-map alternative retained. Trailhead and distanceType must be considered together. Null means unverified, not zero.
coverageNote: Campsites, viewpoints, parks and named lakes do not necessarily have one canonical approach. Do not infer gain from altitude endpoints or straight-line points. Source metadata explicitly distinguishes historical maps from recent field estimates.
